fold.hft_normalizer: inherit exact core checkpoint normalizer; observed hashes must match
fold.outer_fold_exposure: Previously inspected fold; robustness evidence, not a fresh holdout.

source_qualified_fit_membership.membership_semantics: All group identifiers are source-qualified; outer evaluation members are excluded from parent, student, teachers, propensity, and cache fitting.

fold.source_qualified_train_membership: 10,533 train.parquet groups plus 1,416 fold-eligible valid.parquet groups (11,949 source-qualified fit members total); the 457 outer evaluation groups are excluded from parent/student/teacher/propensity fitting.
fold.student_normalizer: fresh over same fold-eligible train+valid groups
fold.teacher_ancestry: Eight own independently trained cleanfold family-teacher sources spanning widths 128/256/384 and raw/full-finetuned, strong-combo, and baseline variants; exact runs and qualified membership are bound by cache metadata.

propensity.fit_membership: Source-qualified fold-1 eligible train+valid fit members only; provenance names the fold-1 split and its valid fit set is disjoint from the 457 outer evaluation groups.

recipe_identity.note: R4 changes operational run IDs and corrects membership bookkeeping only. Scientific parent/student arguments remain identical to R3 F1 templates.

reuse_rules: Reuse only the existing F1 family cache metadata/payload and F1 propensity checkpoint/provenance; do not build teachers, cache, or propensity again.
At actual admission, revalidate cache members, exact propensity, split membership, source exclusions, current profile, quota and output absence.
Never initialize from the all-data Z1c/Z4 public pair or from an F0 checkpoint.
Do not claim fresh holdout evidence from fold 1; it is previously exposed fold robustness evidence.

source_snapshot_bindings.note: R3 immutable source snapshot map; no source snapshot was copied or edited for R4.

split_manifest.exposure: Previously inspected fold; robustness evidence, not a fresh holdout.

teacher_cache.source_exclusion_audit: Eight own independently trained cleanfold family-teacher sources are bound by cache metadata; all use the same fold-1 source-qualified eligible fit membership and exclude the 457 outer evaluation groups. Existing cache/member hashes must be revalidated by the actual consumer before launch.
